runs.text:
We have music with two types of licenses: Standard Music License and Creative Commons. 

Standard Music License means you need to purchase one time license but you will be free from paying any royalties further. You will receive a copyright notice which you can dispute by using license file. Claim will be released within 24 hours.

Creative Commons - means that you free to share, copy and redistribute the material in any medium or format; adapt, remix, transform, and build upon the material for any purpose, even commercially. But you must give appropriate credit (name of author and song) and provide a link to original track.

Pay close attention to description of each video! If you will need more information please visit our official site - romansenykmusic.com If you need any assistance in any question, feel free to contact us via email - romansenykmusic@gmail.com
